vibe: Cyberpunk control deck, retro-futuristic, underground, edgy, terminal-meets-modern-dashboard.

headings.usage: Used for all major headings, widget titles, and brand logos. Gives a wide, technical, cyberpunk feel.

body.usage: Used for all body text, terminal logs, navigation, and stats. Enforces the CLI/Hacker terminal aesthetic.

spacing_and_layout.details: Dense layout, utilizing full screen height. Sidebar for navigation, main content area for the 'Function Library' and top area for Master Control & Terminal logs. Maximize screen real estate. Every widget should have `h-full` to align perfectly with neighbors.
spacing_and_layout.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use `border-white/10` for panels. Active/Hover states should glow with `border-[#00FF41]/50`.

surfaces.retro_terminal: Panels should have a flat #0a0a0a background, sharp 1px borders, and NO soft shadows by default. When hovered or active, introduce a neon glow via `drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,255,65,0.4)]` and text color shift to Neon Green.
surfaces.scanlines: MANDATORY: Add a global or container-specific CSS overlay for scanlines to simulate a CRT terminal monitor. Example: `background: linear-gradient(rgba(18, 16, 16, 0) 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 50%), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.06), rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.02), rgba(0, 0, 255, 0.06)); background-size: 100% 2px, 3px 100%; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.3;`

cyber_avatar.description: User profile avatar for the master control panel

terminal_bg.description: Optional subtle background texture for the entire app or specific hero areas. Use with very low opacity.

components_strategy.toggles: Crucial for this app. Build custom HTML/Tailwind toggle switches that look like mechanical/terminal switches. When ON, the track should be #00FF41 with a strong box-shadow glow. When OFF, it should be dark gray.
components_strategy.terminal_logs: Build a simulated terminal window. It should stream fake log messages automatically using a React `useEffect` interval. Logs should have timestamps, severity levels (INFO, WARN, ERROR), and color-coding. Use JetBrains Mono text-xs or text-sm.
components_strategy.cards: Function cards should have sharp edges (no rounding, or very minimal `rounded-sm`). Display the category as an uppercase tracking-widest badge. Include a small 'status' pulsing dot if the function is active.
components_strategy.icons: Use `lucide-react`. Make them sharp. Size 16px or 20px.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a strictly STATIC UI mockup. No real API calls to Discord.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for complex overlapping or grid components instead of Shadcn if Shadcn is too rigid, but use Shadcn for standard dropdowns/modals if needed.
Implement a Master Control Panel on top with a global connect/disconnect toggle, fake uptime counter, and latency (e.g., '14ms').
Implement the 'Terminal Feed' that auto-scrolls with fake data (e.g., '[14:02:03] [INFO] Loaded module: Sniper').
Display the 20 Function Ideas in a dense 'Bento' or 'Control Room' grid. Each card needs an ON/OFF toggle, Name, Category badge, and short description.
Include a 'cmd-k' style search bar mockup (doesn't need real logic, just UI).
Typography MUST strictly use Unbounded for headers and JetBrains Mono for body. Update `tailwind.config.js` to set these as sans/mono defaults or custom font families.
Background should be very dark (#050505), with scanlines CSS effect overlay to sell the 'terminal' vibe.
Provide intense contrast on active states using the neon green (#00FF41).
Ensure the layout is highly technical. Avoid generic SaaS centered layouts. Align left, use tight tracking on mono text, uppercase overlines.
